macro_library: automate_dv (every hub, link and satellite is a macro call; every hash is computed by automate_dv.stage())
architecture: central views (the user's governing rule) -> automate_dv.stage() -> hub() / link() / sat() / ma_sat()
build_status_note: Every object resolvable from the pinned inputs was built. What was not is REFUSED and registered with whose call it is -- a fallback always produces a row, so it never produces an error.
tree_digest_recipe: per file: posix-relpath + LF + sha256(bytes); lines sorted bytewise, joined by LF, sha256 of the UTF-8 join

check_vault_alignment.note: This gate reported every satellite as unreachable on the previous health build (wrong directory layout). On this build it reaches all of them.

5. alias selected more than once in one.cause: Each central view ends with its last union branch followed by the final windowed select. The gate splits on 'union all' only, so those two selects fall in one block and every payload column -- aliased once in each -- is counted as repeated. Parsed select by select, no alias repeats.

1. and 6. mapped column reaches no satel.cause: Every one of these pairs had ALL of its map rows refused (key unresolved, key calls the undefined normalise(), ...) and registered with whose call it is; none is a landed value under a different name. The shared gate records known gaps only in vault_tools/accepted_uncovered.txt, which this build may not edit.

2. src_pk differs from the sibling.cause: health_dv_dbt names satellite keys *_HK while its hubs and links use *_HKEY -- the split partner_dv_dbt's README records as the defect that broke 14 health hubs. This build uses *_HKEY everywhere, as partner and travel do.

2. grain / src_cdk differs from the sibl.cause: data_7.js governs grain. health_dv_dbt was built against an earlier model; where data_7.js declares a satellite multi-active or declares more child-key legs, this build follows data_7.js.

4. hub key names differ from the sibling.cause: the hub business-key column is <HUB>_BK here, PARENT_BK in health_dv_dbt, partner_dv_dbt and travel_dv_dbt. One view-level stage carries several hubs, so one PARENT_BK column cannot serve them all. This is the one naming deviation from the reference projects.
4. hub key names differ from the sibling.alternative: one stage per (view, hub) naming the key PARENT_BK
